GPU targets are parallel hardware backends, not sequential stages. Zen is generative reasoning; Kai provides decision intelligence. ZAP is a native RPC protocol for supported interconnect paths. Research and evaluation form a gated improvement loop. “Native” describes Hanzo’s architecture surfaces; not every implementation, weight, driver or operating system is owned or open sourced by Hanzo.
